The as-cast alloy is mainly composed of α-Mg matrix, β-Mg5(Gd,Zn) phase, and LPSO phase.

attributes.morphology: network-like or island-like with skeleton structure

evidence.quote: In the as-cast alloy, the network-like or island-like β-Mg5(Gd,Zn) phases with the coarse size and skeleton structure (indicated by red arrows in Fig. 2 a and d) and fine-lamellae LPSO phases (indicated by white arrows in Fig. 2 a) can be observed in the matrix.

In the as-cast alloy, the network-like or island-like β-Mg5(Gd,Zn) phases with the coarse size and skeleton structure (indicated by red arrows in Fig. 2 a and d) and fine-lamellae LPSO phases (indicated by white arrows in Fig. 2 a) can be observed in the matrix.
There is another rod-like phase named the X-Mg 12Gd1Zn1 phase [13,14].

attributes.morphology: broken into small particles, elongated along shear direction

evidence.quote: After 4 passes as shown in Fig. 2 b and c, the primary β phases appear very brittle and are easily broken into small particles, elongated along with the shear direction.

The small particles with the size of about 2 μm, located in the bottom of the dimples as shown in Fig. 5c, has been proven to be the broken β-Mg5(Gd,Zn) phases, with the chemical composition of Mg –(5.7071.0 at%)Zn –(9.7471.0 at%)Gd according to the EDS analysis.

attributes.location: adjacent to strip-distributed beta phase particles and DRX grains

evidence.quote: The SAED pattern demonstrates that the LPSO microcell has a 14H-type structure.
Furthermore, many micrometer-level equiaxed grains can be observed, which are newly formed due to dynamic recrystallization (DRX).
The original straight fine-lamellae LPSO phases also undergo different degrees of bending and form kink bands (indicated by the red dotted line in Fig. 3 e) within the deformed matrix.
The grain size after 16 passes is reduced to 1 –2 μm due to the DRX effect.

attributes.location: within small units of alpha-Mg matrix

evidence.quote: every unit mainly consists of five parts: β phase particles (transparent region, marked by A), micro-sized grain (about 2 μm in diameter, marked by B), ultra-fine grain (less than 1 μm in diameter, marked by C), fine-lamellae LPSO microcells (marked by D) and undefined particle (marked by E).
Up to 16 passes as shown in Fig. 5 b, a great number of dimples appear on the fracture surface, which indicates the great ductility improvement of the alloy.
Moreover, high-density dislocations can be observed within these DRX grains.

For the as-cast condition as shown in Fig. 5 a, the fracture happens along the phase interface between the β phases and the α-Mg matrix, where the fracture positions at the phase interface and the cleavage planes are indicated by white arrows.

conditions.test_method: electronic universal material test machine, extension rate 0.5 mm/min

evidence.quote: After 16 passes, the YS, UTS and elongation to failure reach 324 MPa, 387 MPa and 23.2%, which is 100%, 92.5% and 364% higher than those of the as-cast one, respectively.
